mapper.insert: INSERT INTO r_pan_file_cleanup_task(task_id, real_file_id, storage_type, storage_locator) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{realFileId}, #{storageType}, #{storageLocator})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM r_pan_file_cleanup_task WHERE task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE r_pan_file_cleanup_task SET execution_state='PROCESSING',execution_attempts=execution_attempts+1, lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{until},updated_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND execution_state IN ('PENDING','RETRY','PROCESSING')

UPDATE r_pan_file_cleanup_task SET execution_state='RETRY',delivery_state='PENDING',execution_attempts=0, next_delivery_at=#{now},last_error=NULL,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND execution_state='MANUAL'
